rows.author: F051
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE PHILIPPINE RUBBER AUTHORITY (PhilRA), DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Philippine Rubber Authority Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Establishes the Philippine Rubber Authority that shall promote the development of the rubber industry from research, production, processing, marketing and trade regulation in order to make it globally competitive.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 2008-09-29

rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2009-02-02, transmitted to on 2009-02-04 and received by the Senate on 2009-02-04
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING AN ADDITIONAL LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT IN THE PROVINCE OF CEBU TO BE KNOWN AS THE SEVENTH CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT
rows.status: Substituted by HB05761

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 122 OF REPUBLIC ACT 6938 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE COOPERATIVE CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to exempt non-stock, non-profit electric cooperatives (ECs) from the payment of all national and local taxes, fees, duties and other charges.  It also grants ECs the option to convert either into stock cooperatives or stock corporations.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on COOPERATIVES DEVELOPMENT since 2008-09-29

rows.author: D053
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 62 AND 124  OF REPUBLIC ACT 6938 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE COOPERATIVE CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Seeks to exempt producers cooperatives, specifically agricultural or agro-industrial cooperatives from the EVAT law for bulk purchases of goods integral to its purposes as a cooperative and in its operation to service the needs of its members.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on COOPERATIVES DEVELOPMENT since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO IMPROVE PUBLIC DISSEMINATION OF GOVERNMENT INFORMATION
rows.title_short: Improvement Of Information Access Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks to provide the citizenry timely, complete, equitable and affordable access to government information.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR DRUG AND ALCOHOL TESTING FOR DRIVERS OF PUBLIC UTILITY VEHICLES
rows.title_short: Drugs And Alcohol Testing For Drivers Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Requires owners of public utility vehicles to conduct pre-employment testing of all their drivers for the use of alcohol or prohibited or regulated drugs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING A COMPREHENSIVE PROGRAM OF SUPPORT FOR VICTIMS OF TORTURE
rows.title_short: Comprehensive Torture Victims Relief Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks to provide victims of torture the following services, among others:  a) physical and psychological rehabilitation; and b) social and legal services.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HUMAN RIGHTS since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR CHILDPROOF HANDGUNS
rows.title_short: Childproof Handgun Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Aims to decrease shooting incidents or accidents by requiring gun manufacturers to incorporate in their design a locking device that will prevent the firing of a handgun by unauthorized or unrecognized users specially children.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING QUALITY STANDARDS FOR MINERAL AND CARBONATED WATER
rows.title_short: Safe Bottled Water Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Establishes regulations that shall cover all bottled drinking water including mineral, spring, natural sparkling water and vended water.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT ORDAINING INSTITUTIONAL RESPONSIBILITY IN GIVING TESTIMONY IN CRIMINAL CASES AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS
rows.abstract: Seeks to penalize by fine or imprisonment or both any public official or employee who fails or refuses to appear as a witness in any criminal proceeding.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING AND ENHANCING PUBLIC SAFETY THROUGH THE USE OF UNIVERSAL EMERGENCY ASSISTANCE NUMBER
rows.title_short: Communications And Public Safety Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Requires every provincial government to designate an emergency telephone number to be used for reporting an emergency or requesting assistance within its territorial jurisdiction.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE SURVEILLANCE RESEARCH AND SERVICES AIMED AT THE PREVENTION OF BIRTH DEFECTS
rows.title_short: Birth Defects Prevention Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Establishes a health center in every region that shall be tasked to monitor birth defects, and undertake research on the prevention of birth defects, among others.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THAT ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES CARRY HEALTH WARNINGS ON THEIR CONTAINERS
rows.title_short: Alcoholic Beverage Labelling Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Directs manufacturers, importers, distributors and retailers of alcoholic beverages to indicate in their containers a health warning that  consumption of alcoholic beverages during pregnancies may result in birth defects and may impair one's ability to drive a car or operate a machine.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PROTECTION OF WAGES AND TIPS RECEIVED BY CERTAIN EMPLOYEES
rows.title_short: Wages And Tips Protection Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Provides for mechanics to ensure that gratuities given to wait staff employees, service employees and service barters are not subjected to any deduction or interference by their employers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR UNIFORM STANDARDS OF LIABILITY FOR HARM ARISING OUT OF GENERAL AVIATION ACCIDENTS
rows.title_short: General Aviation Accident Liability Standards Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Provides for a system of determining liability and damages to compensate individuals injured in general aviation accidents.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT MAKING THE MALVERSATION OF RECLAIMED LANDS A CRIME, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 217 OF ACT NO. 3815, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PENAL CODE
rows.abstract: Seeks to penalize by reclusion perpetua to death any public officer who aids, cooperates with or consents to the transfer of reclaimed land in favor of any private corporation without congressional approval.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT, TESTING, AND EVALUATION OF STRATEGIC PLANNING AND PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENT IN THE GOVERNMENT
rows.title_short: Government Performance And Results Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks to minimize wastage and inefficiency in government service by requiring all agencies to submit annually to the Department of Budget and Management a strategic plan for their program activities and a program performance report.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOOD GOVERNMENT AND PUBLIC ACCOUNTABILITY since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING SEXUAL RELATIONS WITH CONSENT BETWEEN PARTIES WHO ARE RELATED BY CONSANGUINITY OR BY REASON OF PUBLIC POLICY, HAVE KNOWLEDGE OF THEIR RELATIONSHIP AND ARE EIGHTEEN (18) YEARS OF AGE AND ABOVE, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES
rows.title_short: Anti-incest Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks to penalize incestuous relationships by prision correctional in its medium or maximum terms.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO DIRECT THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH TO PREPARE AND PUBLISH ANNUALLY A CONSUMER GUIDE TO PRESCRIPTION DRUG PRICES
rows.title_short: Prescription Drug Consumer Information Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Directs the Department of Health to publish the prices of prescription drugs annually.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL CRIME DATABASE
rows.title_short: National Crime Database Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Establishes the interregional identification index system or III system that shall serve as the repository of the records on all crimes and criminals including the records of the national identification index, the national fingerprint files and the records of the National Bureau of Investigation, the Philippine National Police, the courts and other related agencies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ENSURE IMPROVED ACCOUNTABILITY OF ANIMAL EXPERIMENTATION PROGRAMS
rows.title_short: Accountability In Using Animals For Research Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Aims to ensure that animals used for educational, experimentation and other research purposes are obtained legally.  Also requires an annual report on the animals used for such purposes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE & FOOD since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PUNISH TRANSMISSION OF INDECENT MATERIAL BY COMPUTER TO MINORS
rows.title_short: Anti-computer Pornography Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks to punish with imprisonment of not more than six (6) years those responsible for the transmission of indecent materials through computers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING HEARING-IMPAIRED AND SPEECH-IMPAIRED PERSONS ACCESS TO TELECOMMUNICATION SYSTEMS
rows.title_short: Teelcommunication Accessibility Enhancement Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Provides for the installation of telecommunication devices for the deaf and mute or machines that employ graphic communications in the transmission of coded signals.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2008-09-29

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL POLICY OF BASIC CONSUMER FAIR TREATMENT FOR AIRLINE PASSENGERS
rows.title_short: Airline Passenger Fairness Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks to penalize an air carrier or ticket agent who engages in unfair and deceptive practices grossly causing inconvenience to air travellers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2008-09-29
